description: This file defines a class for rendering Box & Whisker charts as part of the Image_Graph plotting library. It extends a base plot class and includes methods for drawing the chart, handling style, and configuring appearance.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_BoxWhisker
classes.description: A class for rendering Box & Whisker chart plots within the Image_Graph PHP graphing library.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerV
methods.description: Draws a vertical Box & Whisker element on the plot.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerH
methods.description: Draws a horizontal Box & Whisker element on the plot.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Performs drawing of a legend sample for the plot.

methods.name: setWhiskerSize
methods.description: Sets the size (radius) of the whisker circles/dots.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes the drawing of the plot, rendering all boxes and whiskers.
